name: Castilleja de la Cuesta (Spain)
description: A yellow hoist third and a fly divided horizontally red over blue, charged with the arms of Castilleja de la Cuesta (a castle on white and cauldrons on blue, within an inscribed ring).
history: Municipal flag of Castilleja de la Cuesta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castilleja de la Cuesta arms — castle on white and cauldrons on blue within an inscribed ring
